liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (5 reviews): Chosen as a Dick's Pick as the best Dark Star, running about thirty minutes; Reviewer says this Dark Star mixes psychedelic rock, jazz and bluegrass [5][6][11][13][14]
- **The Eleven** (2 reviews): The descent into The Eleven stands out, with Jerry's shout, Phil popping bass and Tom on Hammond organ; Reviewer returns to this show mainly for The Eleven and Death Don't Have No Mercy [10][14]
- **Midnight Hour** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Midnight Hour killer [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **In The Midnight Hour**: back after 115 archived shows (438 days) [16]
- **Seasons**: rare: 5 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32273.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 13 songs; 112 min; rated 4.5/5 by 14 [1]
- **gd69-11-02.sbd.goodbear.1125.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 6 songs; 74 min; rated 4.44/5 by 45 [3]
- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32350.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 112 min; rated 4.37/5 by 19 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer ranks this probably the best 1969 Dark Star, though not on everyone's top-ten list [6]
- Its mid-song 'only the beginning' jam came before Chicago's song of that kind, which was released the next year [10]
- The band played another amazing Dark Star only six days later [11]
- The jam near the end of this Dark Star returned in the 10/31/71 Dark Star [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32273.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Disc 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) DDisc 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd69-11-02.sbd.goodbear.1125.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Doug Johnson and Teddy "Good Bear"; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Passed via Teddy GoodBear and Doug Johnson to abg, later reaching etree [3]
- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32350.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Disc 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) DDisc 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]
- Officially released in 2022 as Dave's Picks Volume 43, paired with Dallas, 12/26/69 [18]
